items.name: Get to know Fresh
items.about: Clean, sparkling and airy: citrus peel, sea breeze, crisp herbs. Famous examples include CK One · Acqua di Giò · Light Blue · 4711 Eau de Cologne · Eau Sauvage.
howToSteps: At a perfume counter, ask to try a fresh scent, for example CK One.
Spray a paper strip and smell it now, after 10 minutes and after an hour.
Write down one word for how it makes you feel.

metadata.Smells like: Clean, sparkling and airy: citrus peel, sea breeze, crisp herbs.
metadata.Key notes: Bergamot, lemon, sea notes, green tea, rosemary
metadata.Feels: Bright and energising; great in heat
metadata.Famous examples: CK One · Acqua di Giò · Light Blue · 4711 Eau de Cologne · Eau Sauvage
